title: Capability Gap Mapper
outcome: Continuous visibility into capability deficits with prioritized bridging strategies
breakthrough: Unified capability taxonomy spanning human skills, agent competencies, tool coverage, and infrastructure — enabling automated gap detection and ROI-ranked remediation

subphases.name: 1.1 Taxonomy & Ingestion
work: Define unified capability taxonomy (skills, agents, tools, infra, data, APIs)
Build ingest adapters for HR systems, code repos, agent registries, infra CMDBs
Implement capability normalization and deduplication pipeline

subphases.name: 1.2 Gap Detection Engine
work: Implement desired vs actual capability diffing with semantic matching
Add criticality weighting (business impact, frequency, blast radius)
Build gap clustering to surface systemic themes vs one-offs

subphases.name: 2.1 Bridging Strategy Generator
work: Implement bridging action taxonomy: hire, train, build, buy, partner, automate, defer
Add ROI modeling (cost, time-to-capability, risk, strategic alignment)

subphases.name: 2.2 Progress Tracking & Feedback
work: Implement capability acquisition tracking with leading/lagging indicators
Add feedback loops from outcomes to improve gap predictions
Build drift detection for capability decay and scope creep

subphases.name: 3.1 Integration & Automation
work: Expose REST/gRPC API for CI/CD, planning tools, and agent orchestration
Add webhook notifications for new critical gaps

subphases.name: 3.2 Governance & Scale
work: Implement RBAC for capability data (sensitive skills, strategic gaps)
Add audit trail for bridging decisions and outcomes
Build multi-tenant support for org units and subsidiaries
